name: Midnight Library
source:
In our school, there's an urban legend similar to those of seven wonders.
The school at 10 o' clock in the night, illuminated in the moonlight.
If you search in the archive of the back of the school's library, a certain book will appear.
A crimson cover, with no title and blank pages.
If you recite your wish three times and turn the page, it'll come true.
Just an urban legend, a mysterious wonder.
That's how I thought it was.
Until that time came.

[from [url=http://hazel-nut.jp/story/index.html]Official site[/url]]
translation:
在我们学校，有一个类似于七大奇迹的都市传说。
晚上10点的学校，在月光的照耀下。
如果你在学校图书馆后面的档案室中查找，就会出现某本书。
深红色封面，没有标题，空白页。
如果你把你的愿望念三遍并翻过一页，它就会实现。
只是一个都市传说，一个神秘的奇迹。
我就是这么想的。
直到那一刻到来。

[来自[url=http://hazel-nut.jp/story/index.html]官方网站[/url]]
